pattern: IM-P11 provider date conflicts with tenant; SF the agency email asking the provider bounced; EX-06 weekday mismatch
notes: Mutation of the base cut. Events 001-022 unchanged (022 is the system's 'Please check if we need to provide a response to tenant' trigger). Appended event 023 (new): the agency emails Keystone Compliance asking which date was agreed. Appended event 024 (new): a delivery failure notice two seconds later, mailbox full, no further attempts. History truncated after event 024. The provider has therefore not been asked. Its phone number 07700 900077 is in the confirmations at events 018 and 019. Expected: reach the provider another way (phone or SMS on the number on file) and ask which date was agreed; tell the tenant the date is still being confirmed and that nobody should be expected on 30 August; never state the provider has been asked or has confirmed; hold with a short review date. No escalation, since another route exists.
